cc:Work.dc:title: Cyberpunk 2077 at 3x and 4x with MFG Unlocker
cc:Work.dc:description: AMD BC-250, 2560x1440 SDR, FSR 4 Performance, XeFGModel=default. 3x MFG Unlocker alone: 93.42 FPS; 3x FreeFG 1.0.0: 125.31 FPS; 4x MFG Unlocker alone: 97.75 FPS; 4x FreeFG 1.0.0: 139.92 FPS; 3x +34.1%; 4x +43.1%. Source: docs/data/mfg-3x4x/data.json.
